name: 10pines-c6-holidaycalendar
title: Holiday Calendar
description: A holiday calendar that answers whether a date is a holiday given holidays defined by day of week, day of month or specific date, and then a new requirement: holidays valid only within a date interval. Built from scratch with TDD following slides 54 and 65.
source: 10Pines-Capacitacion/C6 - Construccion de Software Seguro usando Test Driven Development

design.notes: The new requirement (intervals) breaks the first solution based on separate collections per kind of holiday and pushes toward a heterogeneous collection of polymorphic holiday rules, including a rule that decorates another one with a date range (slides 66-67).
